reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The ignore_eoi exported lbool owns the follow-mode policy that treats end-of-input as temporary; it does not own the file or its cached bytes.
owner_creation.invariant: Follow policy is distinct from input ownership.
limitations: ignore_eoi is follow policy and owns no filestate or bytes.

aliases_escapes.analysis: command.rs saves/restores this global around following and ch_length/ch_get read ignore_eoi by value; copied policy does not keep thisfile live.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Policy readers still require a valid filestate owner.
limitations: A policy snapshot must agree with the selected thisfile and file size.

callback_targets.analysis: A true policy enables waiting and direct wait_message/ixerror/sleep calls, which may reenter display state; the ignore_eoi bit stores no callback itself.
callback_targets.invariant: Follow waiting crosses display owners through direct calls.
limitations: Direct read/seek branches consume policy without storing a callback in it.

invalidation.analysis: Changing policy alters whether known fsize is exposed; positions and retained cache aliases are not retired by the ignore_eoi scalar assignment.
invalidation.invariant: Toggling follow does not validate retained positions.

mutation_commit.analysis: The ignore_eoi policy update is not jointly committed with file selection, cached EOF or pending signal state; readers rely on command-loop sequencing.
mutation_commit.invariant: Follow policy and active-file state lack a typed joint owner.

release_pair.analysis: No free applies to the ignore_eoi policy; stopping follow mode does not itself close the file, free cache nodes or end an ifile lifetime.
release_pair.invariant: Leaving follow mode cannot release borrowed storage.
limitations: Restoring policy after a command does not release input resources.

error_cleanup.analysis: With ignore_eoi enabled, a hard read error still sets read_error and returns -1 before fpos/datasize advance. No FD or buffer is released there; ch_close later chooses retain/free by ownership flags.
error_cleanup.invariant: Follow policy does not establish correct I/O failure status.

signals_handoff.analysis: The translated mutable global is read amid signal polling and command changes; ignore_eoi's lifecycle remains within the broad raw-core ownership finding.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 remains recorded for coupled follow state.
limitations: Source review of policy coupling only; no claim that the retained M0-IO-001 read campaign finding is resolved.
The scoped concern is a reentrant reader observing follow policy independently of thisfile/fsize, not a dangling pointer inside ignore_eoi.

src/command.rs.relationship: Command repaint saves, clears and restores ignore_eoi at src/command.rs:1336-1352; follow-mode commands set and clear it at src/command.rs:1700-1725. These are policy changes outside ch.rs.
